facts.attack_4_provider_failure_gap: KNOWN GAP: If a provider accepts a request, processes tokens (incurring real cost), then returns a 5xx error, MeteredTransport records a failure with no charge. The budget ledger never sees the spend because charge() only runs on successful responses. The real money is gone at the provider but the run's budget.spent is understated. This gap is structural: the gateway reports tokens only on success, so the controller has no token count to price. Mitigation: monitor provider-side billing independently of the agent's ledger. PR #2 by BavyaBalakrishnan demonstrated this with a mock provider that consumed tokens then raised.
